claim.claim-text: 2. The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the imaging unit performs a dynamic scan through which a dynamic image of a scan subject portion of the subject is reconstructed by repeatedly irradiating a region including the scan subject portion with X-rays.

3. The apparatus according to claim 2, wherein the imaging unit detects X-rays with a Flat Panel Detector of multiple arrays that can simultaneously detect X-rays passed through a region including the scan subject portion.

4. The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the switch-timing detecting unit creates a curve that indicates temporal variations in the contrast medium density based on the index value, and detects switch timing of the scanning conditions based on a gradient of the created curve.

5. The apparatus according to claim 4, wherein the index-value detecting unit detects an index value that indicates a contrast medium density in an region of interest set on the image as the index value, and the switch-timing detecting unit creates a curve that indicates temporal variations in the contrast medium density in the region of interest as the curve.
6. The apparatus according to claim 4, wherein the switch-timing detecting unit detects the switch timing by detecting an inflection point that appears on the curve based on a gradient of the curve.

7. The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the imaging control unit controls the imaging unit so as to skip the rest of a scan currently in execution and to terminate scanning, when an index value detected by the index-value detecting unit becomes below a termination threshold value.

8. The apparatus according to claim 1, wherein the imaging control unit controls the imaging unit so as to skip the rest of a scan currently in execution and to terminate scanning, when a total scan time from a start of the scan reaches a predetermined maximum scan time.

9. The apparatus according to claim 1, further comprising a display control unit that displays during a scan a curve that indicates temporal variations in the contrast medium density based on index values detected by the index-value detecting unit.

10. An X-ray CT apparatus comprising: an imaging unit that irradiates a subject, switching scanning conditions, with X-rays continuously or intermittently, and reconstructs an image by detecting X-rays passed through the subject; an index-value detecting unit that detects an index value that indicates a contrast medium density in an image reconstructed by the imaging unit during a scan; and a display control unit that displays during a scan a curve that indicates temporal variations in the contrast medium density based on index values detected by the index-value detecting unit.

11. The apparatus according to claim 10, further comprising: an instruction receiving unit that receives from an operator an instruction to skip the rest of a scan with a first scanning condition in execution and to start a scan with a second scanning condition; and an imaging control unit that controls the imaging unit so as to skip the rest of a scan with the first scanning condition and to start a scan with the second scanning condition upon receiving by the instruction receiving unit an instruction about switching of scanning conditions.

12. The apparatus according to claim 10, wherein the index-value detecting unit detects an index value that indicates a contrast medium density in an region of interest set on the image as the index value, and the display control unit displays during a scan a curve that indicates temporal variations in the contrast medium density in the region of interest as the curve.

13. The apparatus according to claim 12, wherein the display control unit displays a plurality of curves that indicates temporal variations in contrast medium densities in respective regions of interest, when a plurality of regions of interest is set on the image as the region of interest.
14. The apparatus according to claim 10, wherein the display control unit further displays information about executed scans during a scan.

16. The method according to claim 15, wherein the imaging unit performs a dynamic scan through which a dynamic image of a scan subject portion of the subject is reconstructed by repeatedly irradiating a region including the scan subject portion with X-rays.

17. The method according to claim 16, wherein the imaging unit detects X-rays with a Flat Panel detector of multiple arrays that can simultaneously detect X-rays passed through a region including the scan subject portion.

18. The method according to claim 15, wherein the switch-timing detecting unit creates a curve that indicates temporal variations in the contrast medium density based on the index value, and detects switch timing of the scanning conditions based on a gradient of the created curve.

19. The method according to claim 18, wherein the index-value detecting unit detects an index value that indicates a contrast medium density in an region of interest set on the image as the index value, and the switch-timing detecting unit creates a curve that indicates temporal variations in the contrast medium density in the region of interest as the curve.
20. The method according to claim 18, wherein the switch-timing detecting unit detects the switch timing by detecting an inflection point that appears on the curve based on a gradient of the curve.

21. The method according to claim 15, wherein the imaging control unit controls the imaging unit so as to skip the rest of a scan currently in execution and to terminate scanning, when an index value detected by the index-value detecting unit becomes below a termination threshold value.

22. The method according to claim 15, wherein the imaging control unit controls the imaging unit so as to skip the rest of a scan currently in execution and to terminate scanning, when a total scan time from a start of the scan reaches a predetermined maximum scan time.

23. The method according to claim 15, further comprising displaying by a display control unit during a scan a curve that indicates temporal variations in the contrast medium density based on index values detected by the index-value detecting unit.

24. A tomography method comprising: irradiating a subject, switching scanning conditions, with X-rays continuously or intermittently, and reconstructing an image by detecting X-rays passed through the subject, by an imaging unit; detecting by an index-value detecting unit an index value that indicates a contrast medium density in an image reconstructed by the imaging unit during a scan; and displaying by a display control unit during a scan a curve that indicates temporal variations in the contrast medium density based on index values detected by the index-value detecting unit.

25. The method according to claim 24, further comprising: receiving by an instruction receiving unit from an operator an instruction to skip the rest of a scan with a first scanning condition in execution and to start a scan with a second scanning condition; and controlling the imaging unit by an imaging control unit so as to skip the rest of a scan with the first scanning condition and to start a scan with the second scanning condition upon receiving by the instruction receiving unit an instruction about switching of scanning conditions.

26. The method according to claim 25, wherein the index-value detecting unit detects an index value that indicates a contrast medium density in an region of interest set on the image as the index value, and the display control unit displays during a scan a curve that indicates temporal variations in the contrast medium density in the region of interest as the curve.

27. The method according to claim 24, wherein the display control unit displays a plurality of curves that indicates temporal variations in contrast medium densities in respective regions of interest, when a plurality of regions of interest is set on the image as the region of interest.
28. The method according to claim 24, wherein the display control unit further displays information about executed scans during a scan.
